walkthroughs.body_html:
Ethical Legal & Environmental Impacts — a core area of GCSE Computer Science.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Ethical Legal & Environmental Impacts brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Ethical Legal & Environmental Impacts.

mcqs.q: Which technique involves breaking a problem into smaller sub-problems?

Decomposition
Iteration
Encapsulation

mcqs.q: What is the purpose of a trace table?
options: To compile code
To track variable values during execution
To draw a flowchart
To store program output

mcqs.q: Which item is removed first from a stack?
options: Only the inner columns of each table.
Any item, randomly.
The most recently added (top) - LIFO.
The first one added (FIFO).

mcqs.q: What does an INNER JOIN return?
options: Only the inner columns of each table.
Only rows with matching values in both tables.
Any item, randomly.
All rows from both tables combined.

mcqs.q: What is the worst-case complexity of bubble sort?
options: O(n) because it just passes through the list.
O(log n).
Only the inner columns of each table.
O(n squared).
